triage.description:
Triage a synthetic backlog: post it to the swarm board, then start specialists,
reviewers and one lead per team, and reply once every team has run out of issues.

Simulation.description:
How the scripted agents behave. Every agent draws from these with ``workflow.random()``,
so a run is replayable even though it looks noisy.

think_seconds.description: How long a worker 'thinks' about one issue, uniformly between the two.
think_seconds.title: Think Seconds

consult_rate.description: How often a worker consults a specialist.
consult_rate.title: Consult Rate

review_rate.description: How often a worker asks a reviewer to check.
review_rate.title: Review Rate

rework_rate.description: How often a reviewer sends an issue back to be reworked once.
rework_rate.title: Rework Rate

error_rate.description: How often a specialist fails, so the worker releases its issue to the board for another try.
error_rate.title: Error Rate

approval_rate.description: How often a worker wants to close an issue as won't-fix, a gated call that waits for a human to approve it in the console. Each one blocks the run until it is answered, so this is off unless you want to watch a bottleneck form.
approval_rate.title: Approval Rate

Simulation.title: Simulation

agents_started.description: Every agent the run started, retired ones included.
agents_started.title: Agents Started

releases.description: Times a worker handed an issue back to the board.
releases.title: Releases

TriageRun.description: Triage a synthetic backlog with a swarm of agents.

issues.description: Issues to post to the board.
issues.title: Issues

workers_per_team.description: Workers each lead keeps busy at once.
workers_per_team.title: Workers Per Team

items_per_worker.description: Issues a worker handles before it retires and its lead starts a fresh one.
items_per_worker.title: Items Per Worker
